title: Chimichurri
description: Raw parsley, oregano, garlic, and vinegar loosened with oil. Chopped by hand, never blended — a food processor turns it into green paste.
notes: Makes about a cup. Keeps a week refrigerated, though the parsley darkens after day two.

steps.text: Dissolve the salt in the warm water and add the dried oregano to rehydrate it.
steps.tip: Dried oregano straight into oil stays woody. Water first.

steps.text: Chop the parsley, garlic, and red chilli finely by hand and combine them in a bowl.
Stir in the oregano mixture and the red wine vinegar, then pour in the olive oil and stir once — it should stay loose and separated, not emulsified.

steps.tip: It tastes harsh for the first half hour and then settles.
